How it drives

Solid control and drift with slower acceleration. TORQUE makes OVERCHARGE preparation central to the car’s character.

Original perk

OVERCHARGE builds BOOST TANK to 5/5 and has a stronger KICK.

epic Can also be installed on other cars through PERKULATOR.

Try a build

APEX GRIP complements the stronger KICK with extra control and acceleration. Avoid spending the charge before the exit opens.

Practice: Dead Canyon. Explore APEX GRIP.

Example SHIFT setup

One legal example moves one point per attribute. Lower TOP SPEED, ACCELERATION, CONTROL; raise DRIFT, BOOST POWER, BOOST TANK. Try the two states on the same section to feel the trade-off.

Set up SHIFT in GARAGE after 1,000 trophies · Shift.
